ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: All covered persons must be screened against HM Treasury (UK) Sanctions List, UN Security Council Consolidated List, OFAC SDN List, and domestic Bermuda financial sanctions. Politically exposed persons (PEPs), including foreign and domestic prominent persons, must undergo enhanced due diligence (EDD), recordal of source of funds, and senior management approval. Statutory requirement under Bermuda AML/CFT regime as implemented by the Bermuda Monetary Authority.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Bermuda corporate and business services online portal: https://www.gov.bm/corporate-and-business-services
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Names in Latin/Roman alphabet are mandatory. The suffix 'Limited Partnership' or 'L.P.' must be included. Transliteration into English/Roman script is required for any non-Roman name; no Chinese or other scripts are accepted in the registered legal name. Use of 'Limited' or 'Ltd.' alone (without 'Partnership' or 'L.P.') is not compliant for an ELP.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Name reservation may be extended once for an additional 30 days upon payment of the prescribed extension fee before expiry. If the name is rejected due to conflict or prohibited words, the applicant has 14 days from rejection to file a written appeal with the Registrar of Corporate and Business Services, attaching legal submissions and evidence; if the Registrar affirms the rejection, the applicant may appeal to the Minister of Finance within 21 days of the affirmance decision.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual-only offices are not permitted for incorporation. A physical registered office in Bermuda, maintained by a licensed corporate service provider or an exempted company acting as provider, is mandatory. The office need not be full-time staffed for the ELP, but the registered agent must have an active physical presence in Bermuda; acceptance of a virtual trade/service arrangement for operations is permissible only where the registered agent remains the local statutory address holder.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low risk for this typical non-regulated MMORPG publisher (estimated at 2-5% probability). Risk of on-site inspection will increase if substance claims trigger a Bermuda Economic Substance Act 2018 filing or the entity does not maintain the requisite records at the registered office.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Exempted Limited Partnership Act 2015 (as amended), sections 4 and 5 (registration and certificate of registration); supplemented by the Limited Partnership Act 1883 to the extent not inconsistent.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of Companies, Bermuda (Registry General Division, Ministry of Finance)
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Registration as an Exempted Limited Partnership (Form LP-1)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital is prescribed by Bermuda law for an exempted limited partnership. No escrow or blocked capital account is required; contributions are fixed by the limited partnership agreement.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the formation of the Exempted Limited Partnership be approved and that an application for registration be submitted to the Registrar of Companies, Bermuda, under the Exempted Limited Partnership Act 2015. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the registered office of the Partnership shall be established at the address set forth in the application, and that the registered agent shall be appointed. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the General Partner be, and it hereby is, authorized to execute all formation documents, open bank accounts, and retain counsel and accountants for the Partnership. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the Chief Partnership Officer (or equivalent) be appointed to oversee compliance with Bermuda laws. This resolution shall be effective as of the date of filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Companies, Bermuda (Online Name Reservation Portal)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit an online application for name approval via the Registry's e-services gateway, specifying the proposed ELP name and the desired reservation term (1–5 years). Attach a signed consent from the proposed general partner. If the name is acceptable, a Name Reservation Certificate is issued.
required_dossiers: Consent of the proposed general partner
Proof of identification for the general partner
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused, file a fresh application under an alternative name or request reconsideration in writing within 14 days; the Registrar will issue a reasoned response within 10 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registry General, Ministry of Finance, Bermuda (Counter or Online e-Registry)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare and file the Application for Registration as an Exempted Limited Partnership together with the executed Limited Partnership Agreement, the Statement of the General Partner (Form LP-2), and the registered office consent. Ensure all documents are executed in accordance with the ELPA. Submit the filing bundle either electronically or at the Registry counter during business hours.
required_dossiers: Statement of the general partner (Form LP-2)
Consent of the registered office provider
Power of attorney (if submission by agent)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar issues a query, respond with a supplementary declaration within 15 working days; the review process is suspended pending receipt, and an extension may be requested by letter.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Fee Payment and Certificate of Registration Issuance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Bermuda Government Cashier / e-Payment Portal (Registry of Companies)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon acceptance of the application, pay the statutory filing fee (USD 2,000) through the government's e-payment system or by bank draft payable to the Accountant General. Retain the payment receipt. After confirmation of funds, the Registrar will issue the Certificate of Registration of an Exempted Limited Partnership.
required_dossiers: Payment receipt or bank transfer confirmation
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the certificate is delayed, file a formal email inquiry with the Registry; if the certificate contains inaccuracies, apply for rectification under section 8 of the ELPA with evidence of the error.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Appointment of Registered Agent and Registered Office
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registered Agent (licensed under the Companies Act 1981) / Registrar of Companies for notification
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Appoint a Bermuda-licensed registered agent and execute the registered office consent. Notify the Registrar of the appointment by filing the Notice of Registered Office and Agent (Form LP-3) within 21 days of any change. The registered office must be a physical address in Bermuda.
required_dossiers: Identity documents for the registered agent's beneficial owner
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notice is rejected, correct the form and refile; failure to maintain a registered office may result in automatic dissolution, so the remedy is immediate corrective filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Bermuda Economic Substance Board (Registrar of Companies) and Office of the Tax Commissioner
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Evaluate whether the ELP carries on a relevant activity under the Economic Substance Act 2019. If applicable, file the annual Economic Substance Return within 6 months of the financial year-end. Also file the tax information declaration with the Tax Commissioner to confirm exemption status. Maintain current records with the registered agent.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the economic substance return is queried, provide the requested supporting documentation (payroll, operations evidence) within 30 days; for tax declaration, correct discrepancies and submit a revised declaration.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable – no industrial licensing board has jurisdiction over digital publishing; the Minister of Economic Development acts in an administrative capacity for extraordinary permits.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not required – the undertaking is a digital content publisher, not an industrial or physical facility operator.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environment and Natural Resources, Bermuda
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt – no physical project or emissions-generating installation; digital publishing falls outside the prescribed undertakings in the Environmental Impact Assessment Regulations.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable to pure digital operations. If office premises are used, wastewater discharge shall comply with the Ministry of Health standards. Any backup generator for office continuity must meet Bermuda Air Discharge Standards for benzene, CO, NOx, SOx, and VOC emission thresholds.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: No special civil defense license is required. For any administrative office, secure a fire safety certificate from the Bermuda Fire and Rescue Service, and comply with the Occupational Safety and Health (Defence) Act 1985 for workplace clearance.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Office of the Tax Commissioner — Bermuda Tax Administration (BermudaTA), official portal: taxcommissioner.gov.bm; Bermuda Customs Department (ASYCUDA World) for customs duties; Registrar of Companies, Ministry of Finance, for Exempted Limited Partnership registration and annual declarations.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Bermuda maintains no traditional TIN registry because it is a zero-tax, no-VAT jurisdiction for offshore structures. A foreign-owned ELP obtains its statutory identity by: (1) filing an application under the Exempted Partnerships Act 1992 (EPA 1992) with the Registrar of Companies and paying the annual government fee, obtaining a Certificate of Exempted Partnership (this certificate number functions as the corporate identifier; no VAT ID exists); (2) maintaining a registered office in Bermuda and a Bermuda-resident person authorized to accept service of process; (3) filing the annual EPA declaration with the Registrar; (4) registering separately with BermudaTA only for Payroll Tax (if staff are Bermuda-resident) and acquiring a customs importer code only if physical goods are imported; and (5) obtaining a Bermuda Tax Reference Number for CIT registration solely if the wider MNE group is in scope of the Corporate Income Tax Act 2025 (consolidated revenue of at least EUR 750 million in either of the two preceding fiscal years). Platform payments from Apple App Store and Google Play can be collected in Bermuda bank accounts without any VAT or withholding tax registration.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: US check-the-box: the Bermuda ELP is an eligible entity under Treas. Reg. Sec. 301.7701-3 and defaults to fiscally transparent partnership treatment unless an affirmative Form 8832 election is made to classify it as an association taxable as a corporation. Bermuda domestic: EPA 1992 section 4A permits an election to confer separate legal personality on the ELP without disturbing the default pass-through treatment for Bermudian tax purposes. CIT/GloBE: an in-scope MNE group may file the Bermuda transitional CbCR Safe Harbour and UTPR Safe Harbour elections and may rely on the Bermuda Corporate Income Tax Act 2025 QDMTT design to protect the primary right to tax top-up profits.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: None — Bermuda imposes no VAT, GST, sales tax, or digital services tax; the only indirect-type taxes are customs import duties under the Customs Tariff Act 1974 (standard rate approximately 22.5% on most physical merchandise) and a hotel-occupancy Tourist Tax. UK VAT (20%) does not extend to the British Overseas Territory of Bermuda and creates no registration nexus for this ELP absent independent UK taxable supplies.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No indirect-tax turnover threshold exists. Customs registration is required only for persons physically importing goods into Bermuda via the ASYCUDA World importer code. For CIT only: in-scope multinational groups with consolidated global revenue of at least EUR 750 million (approx. USD 800 million) in either of the two preceding fiscal years must register with BermudaTA within the Corporate Income Tax Act 2025 deadlines.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No continuous-transaction-control e-invoicing, real-time fiscal clearance, digital stamping, or mandatory tax-API regime exists in Bermuda. Import/export declarations are filed electronically through ASYCUDA World (UN/EDIFACT CUSP messages). MMORPG in-app purchase receipts from Apple App Store and Google Play require no local e-invoice, fiscal stamp, or clearance because the digital supply has no Bermudian consumption-tax nexus.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Not applicable as a VAT concept: with no VAT, there is no 0% export rate, no input-VAT refund claim, and no offshore-services zero-rating procedure. Structural substitute treatment for the global hardcore MMORPG model: (i) digital content delivered through app stores is outside all Bermudian consumption tax and requires no export declaration; (ii) any physical goods (e.g., limited-edition merchandise) exported from Bermuda attract no export duty and are evidenced only for the destination jurisdiction's customs; (iii) an ELP with a real Bermuda office can claim customs duty concessions on imported development hardware/software used exclusively for the qualifying international business.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: ASYCUDA World Export Declaration (only where physical merchandise is exported from Bermuda)
Bill of Lading or Airway Bill evidencing export movement
Bermuda Chamber of Commerce Certificate of Origin where required by the destination customs authority
Inward remittance or platform payout evidence (Apple App Store/Google Play settlement statements, SWIFT MT103) as sub-statutory proof of consideration for economic substance or group audit purposes
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: No VAT clawback is possible because no VAT is charged. Customs duty evasion under the Customs Tariff Act 1974 is punishable by seizure and forfeiture of goods, fines of up to three times the duty evaded, and imprisonment; customs duty concessions are retrospectively clawed back with interest if the goods are diverted or the qualifying status ceases. For CIT: late or inaccurate BermudaTA filings attract interest and penalties under the Corporate Income Tax Act 2025, and an in-scope ELP failing to pay the local QDMTT exposes the wider group to top-up tax abroad under the GloBE IIR/UTPR rules. Continuing non-compliance can result in the Registrar of Companies striking the ELP off the exempted register or revoking its exempted status.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Bermuda Monetary Authority (BMA) as the integrated regulator for banking, insurance, and AML/ATF in Bermuda; the Bermuda Ministry of Finance remains responsible for exchange control policy under the Exchange Control Act 1972, with the BMA acting as the delegated agent for exchange-control approvals.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Bermuda dollar is pegged to the US dollar at 1:1 and both currencies circulate interchangeably in the domestic economy. Bermuda maintains exchange control under the Exchange Control Act 1972, but the regime is administered with a liberal posture: payments for current account transactions, including dividends, profit remittances, and trade-related disbursements, receive routine approval where the underlying transaction is evidenced and compliant with BMA reporting thresholds. The convertibility risk for an Exempted Limited Partnership is not currency inconvertibility but regulatory timing: certain transactions require prior notification or post-event reporting, and funds routed via the United Kingdom may be subject to the UK's retained sanctions and Counter-Terrorism sanctions screening. Capital account transactions, especially capital injections above the BMA or UK reporting thresholds, may require a Regulated Activity or Financial Sanctions assessment but are otherwise freely convertible. Repatriation of profits by a Bermuda ELP with non-Bermuda partners is permissible provided the partnership is not resident for Bermuda tax purposes on the relevant basis, or if it is tax-resident in another jurisdiction with acceptable treaty or economic substance posture, and the distribution is supported by audited or accountants' certificates evidencing available profits. Practical hurdle: US-dollar finality and UK correspondent clearing require sound counterparty due diligence; no material convertibility restriction is expected for a hardcore MMORPG in-app-purchase business, which is a digital services revenue stream with no physical Bermudian market nexus.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: There is no statutory requirement in Bermuda for exporters to surrender foreign currency receipts to the central bank or any monetary authority; Bermuda is not an EEA member state and does not operate a non-resident convertibility or surrender regime akin to PRC or other Asian exchange-control frameworks. Bermuda does not maintain reserve requirements obliging the conversion of export earnings. The relevant obligations fall under the Exchange Control Act 1972 and the BMA's Exchange Control Notices: Bermudian-dollar accounts and foreign-currency accounts may be freely held by an Exempted Limited Partnership as a designated 'external account' holder, and receipts in USD, GBP, EUR, or other currencies can be retained without mandatory conversion. Reporting obligations arise only where the transaction value engages the Anti-Money Laundering (AML) threshold for record-keeping (Bermuda AML/ATF Regulations 2018) or where the payment involves a sanctioned jurisdiction or person. If a Bermuda-domiciled ELP is treated as a tax resident of the United Kingdom under the UK's partnership transparency rules or the corporate residency tests, UK exchange-control rules do not require surrender either; the UK has no general foreign-currency surrender rule since the end of the 1970s. The practical compliance duty consists of maintaining accurate records of the receipt of Apple and Google payout settlements, and ensuring that any intra-group or partner capital distributions are coded correctly for the underlying platform's payout reporting, which is primarily a US withholding and VAT/GST reporting concern, not an FX surrender concern.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of N.T. Butterfield & Son Limited (Bermuda branch)
RBC Royal Bank of Canada (Bermuda) Limited

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Medium feasibility with legal constraints. Bermuda is a regulated 'fintech-friendly' jurisdiction under the Digital Assets Business Act 2018 (DABA) and the Banking, Trust Companies, and Investment Companies Act 1987, but the BMA does not issue European-style Electronic Money Institution (EMI) licenses. A UK-issued EMI (e-money institution) authorized by the Financial Conduct Authority under the Electronic Money Regulations 2011, or an EU/EEA EMI passporting into the UK, can be operationally used by the Bermuda ELP to bank in GBP and EUR, but it will not provide a Bermuda banking relationship or a US-dollar clearable Bermudian account. EMI viability is Medium because the entity is a digital gaming publisher receiving payouts from Apple and Google, which route via commercial bank accounts in the US and Hong Kong, and the EMI can support multi-currency account abstraction, but the ELP still needs a principal bank with US clearing ability to receive USD settlement from the app stores. Legal constraints: EMIs cannot lend, cannot take deposits from the public under a banking license framework, and may impose sub-account restrictions; additionally, Bermuda's Exchange Control Act requires local banking activity to be licensed by the BMA. A UK EMI is not licensed in Bermuda and therefore must not hold out to be a depositary or engage in Bermuda-regulated banking business; its role must be limited to electronic money distribution and payment facilitation. The name and address of the Bermuda ELP must align across the EMI, the principal bank, and the app store payout tax documents to avoid an AML/ATF mismatch.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Bermuda law does not statutorily require the general partner or the limited partners of an ELP to attend the bank in person, but in practice the BMA-supervised banks require a physical or video-identification KYC interview for each (i) general partner, (ii) beneficial owner controlling 25% or more of the partnership, (iii) ultimate beneficial owner of the corporate general partner, and (iv) any individual authorized signatory. HSBC Bermuda and Butterfield generally mandate an in-person or video-conference interview with the compliance officer if no existing banking relationship exists; remote opening is available but is conditioned on: (a) verifying the ELP registration certificate and limited partnership agreement, (b) receiving a notarized certificate of good standing from the Bermuda Registrar of Companies, (c) obtaining a legal opinion from Bermuda counsel (Conyers, Carey Olsen, Appleby, Walkers) confirming the ELP's valid existence, the authority of its general partner, and the absence of any AML red flag, and (d) completing a sanctions and adverse-media screening. HMRC regulations in the UK do not govern Bermuda bank onboarding, but if an FCA-regulated UK EMI is used, the EMI's own 'POCA 2002' and Sanctions Act obligations override purely commercial considerations. A physical appearance is not a legal mandate for a pure low-risk digital publishing ELP, but a senior officer of the general partner should be prepared to attend or participate in a live video call at short notice to meet the banks' risk-appetite policies. Since this ELP's payment rails are Apple and Google payouts, the banks will scrutinize the underlying payout statements and the commercial agreement with the app stores; therefore the interview should be framed as an institutional digital-gaming treasury operation with no cash-intensive or third-party payment complexity.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Bermuda ELP registered with an offshore corporate service provider and no tangible office in Bermuda triggers 'offshore conduit' red flag in the bank's AML/CTF risk rating.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide (i) the BMA-approved or registered exempted limited partnership certificate, (ii) an up-to-date register of beneficial owners filed with the Beneficial Ownership Transparency Act 2017 (or a valid BOTA secure search exclusion), (iii) a substantive business narrative confirming the ELP is an operating copyright owner for a specific MMORPG with a live developer contract and app-store agreements, (iv) the Apple Developer Program and Google Play Console enrollment documents showing the ELP as the registered payee, (v) projected payout statements or historical payout history from App Store Connect and Google Play Console, (vi) a physical presence or substance plan showing registered office, use of Bermuda counsel as resident agent, and any director/partner travel itinerary, and (vii) a letter of explanation signed by the general partner addressing the absence of local staff and confirming that no tax evasion or illicit streaming piracy risk exists.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: The ELP's structure is a pass-through partnership with no corporate tax ID in Bermuda, creating beneficial-ownership complexity for the bank's economic substance and FATCA/CRS classification.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Deliver (i) the partnership agreement and any deed of limited partnership outlining the general partner and limited partner roles, (ii) FATCA/CRS self-certification forms (Form W-8 or Bermuda Revenue Department CRS form) correctly identifying the ELP as a non-financial entity (NFE) or passive NFE, (iii) a copy of the Bermuda Economic Substance Declaration filed with the BMA confirming that the 'pure equity holding' or 'no relevant activity' declaration is not applicable because the ELP is not a pure holding entity, or alternatively documenting the relevant activity as 'headquarters' or 'distribution and service center' if the MMORPG publishing team is in Bermuda, (iv) a capital structure memorandum explaining where ultimate beneficial ownership sits (individual founders, Norwegian or other parent entities), (v) signed legal opinion from Bermuda counsel confirming that profits are allocated to partners in a transparent manner for US federal tax purposes, and (vi) if any US person is a partner, a binding US federal tax classification election (Form 8832) and IRS W-8/W-9 evidence to prevent the bank from treating the ELP as a potentially reportable foreign financial institution.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: The MMORPG's in-app-purchase revenue is generated through Apple and Google app stores, but the bank perceives applicable money-laundering risks associated with virtual currencies, gaming tokens, or player-to-player trading.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide (i) the current App Store Connect and Google Play Console payout terms verifying the settlement approach (no direct player-to-player fiat, no integrated wallet), (ii) an independent AML risk assessment of the game's in-app purchases confirming that the game does not permit unregulated virtual-currency exchanges or convertible virtual asset withdrawal to fiat, (iii) the platform's refund, chargeback, and fraud-control policies, (iv) a statement of fact that the ELP only receives net app-store proceeds at periodic settlement and never touches payment transactions directly, (v) if the game introduces any player-to-player marketplace, furnish a Third-Party Payment Processor (TPP) or money-laundering/financing licensing opinion from the applicable gaming jurisdiction, and (vi) a copy of the technical architecture description showing that any in-game tokens are non-convertible to fiat without app-store processing, thus eliminating a money-laundering vector.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: The ELP has no historical audited financial statements and the bank requires evidence of the source of the initial capital injection, especially if the initial capital is contributed shortly after formation by a non-Bermudian partner.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Produce (i) a source-of-funds dossier comprising the partners' bank statements for the last six months or a certified copy of the wire instructions and SWIFT MT103 or MT203 confirmation, (ii) an executed capital contribution ledger showing the book entries in the ELP's partnership capital accounts, (iii) the ELP's inception balance sheet or an accountant's report prepared by a Bermuda-licensed or UK-chartered accountant, (iv) the ultimate beneficial owners' personal wealth evidence if a capital contribution exceeds US$50,000 (e.g., sale of equity, salary slips, liquidation distribution), (v) a capital call notice and partnership resolution confirming the rationale for the injection (future marketing/development of the MMORPG), and (vi) confirmation that all anticipated capital injections and distributions are routed through banking channels and not via virtual assets or cash.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: The permitted relationship between the Bermuda ELP and the UK entity of the same composite structure (GB's 'sovereign_country' role and KY_ELP's 'jurisdiction') creates a tax-residency uncertainty, causing banks to fear that UK HMRC could later treat the ELP as a UK tax resident, requiring enhanced corporate tax IDs and CRS-FATCA recalibration.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide (i) a UK tax-residency opinion from an English-licensed tax counsel explaining the dual-residency tie-breaker under the UK-Bermuda tax information exchange arrangement and the UK's statutory residency tests (central management and control analysis), (ii) Bermuda corporate income liability evidence: since Bermuda introduces a domestic minimum corporate tax under the Income Tax Act 2024 (Economic Substance and Tax) framework, the bank should receive a tax status letter from the BMA confirming whether the ELP is within the scope of Bermuda's 15% global minimum tax (Pillar Two) top-up, (iii) the board/partner meeting minutes proving all high-level decisions occur in Bermuda (or at least outside the UK), (iv) the registered office address and any UK fixed place of business documentation, (v) agreements with UK service providers avoiding the creation of a UK permanent establishment (no fixed establishment, no UK-dependent agent), (vi) a CRS classification memorandum demonstrating how the ELP is treated as a collectively managed passive NFE reporting through Bermuda's international tax compliance portal, and (vii) a signed undertaking that any changes in UK tax-residency would be promptly disclosed to the bank and that the ELP will maintain sufficient records to identify UK source income and VAT/GST flows from UK users of the game.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: The payment rails list includes Apple_App_Store_Payout and Google_Play_Payout, and the bank flags that app-store payouts are often made to the developer's local entity or a US bank account using a different legal name than the Bermuda ELP, raising a beneficial-ownership mismatch.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide (i) the App Store Connect 'Banking and Tax' settings screen or official notification showing the legal entity name matching exactly the ELP name on the bank account, (ii) an assignment agreement between the actual developer entity and the ELP assigning the app-store revenue rights to the ELP, (iii) Apple and Google payout address verification letters, (iv) HSBC/Butterfield or EMI account statements showing the legal name as 'KY_ELP' or its registered name, (v) a consolidated treasury confirmation letter from the accountant listing all registered account entities and any variant names in App Store Connect/Google Play, and (vi) a free-zone or intermediary letter from a managing partner explaining that the ELP is the publishing and monetization vehicle while the developer is a separate group company.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant routing for capital injecting from UK/EU/US investors into the Bermuda ELP should be denominated in USD, GBP, or EUR and transmitted by bank wire (SWIFT MT103) or, for GBP domestic UK funding, Faster Payments for sub-£1 million with subsequent SWIFT onward transfer. For Bermuda bank accounts, the recommended protocol is: (i) the investor instructs its UK or offshore bank to effect an international SWIFT payment to the ELP's Bermuda bank account using the beneficiary's full registered ELP name, the ABA/IBAN equivalent, and the bank's SWIFT code; (ii) the payment purpose/message field must include a clear reference such as 'Capital Contribution to Bermuda ELP [certificate no.] pursuant to LP Agreement' and should use the appropriate cross-border payment purpose code. The UK's BOP/IDR and the EU/EEA transactions are regulated for sanctions purposes, so the payment must screen against OFAC, HMT, EU, and UN sanctions lists. If the injection is paid to a UK-based EMI account (e.g., a UK EMI EUR or GBP account), the ELP can accept the funds as electronic money, then onward-transfer in stages to the Bermuda bank; however, careful attention must be paid to the AML character of the second leg because a UK EMI may treat the ELP as a pass-through, requiring a purpose code and a source-of-funds declaration. For FATCA/CRS, the inbound capital injection should be documented under the partnership capital accounts and the contributing partner must provide a self-certification of its tax residence. Since Bermuda is not in the EU's blacklist and has an AEOI arrangement with the UK, the receiving bank will report CRS details of the partner who receives an allocation of capital as an equity interest (the ELP is treated as a non-reporting NFE for CRS purposes if it is not a financial institution). The capital must be used for the stated MMORPG publishing activity; if the contribution exceeds the bank's internal threshold (typically US$250,000 or US$500,000), the bank will require a source-of-funds questionnaire and possibly a site visit or video call. A prudent approach is to make the injection from the partner's own account, not an intermediary or pooled E-wallet, and to avoid structuring or 'smurfing' through multiple small transfers, which would violate Bermuda's AML/ATF suspicious-transaction reporting rules. All inbound wires should include a purpose code of 'Capital subscription to a Bermuda exempted limited partnership' and must be recorded with the bank's FX conversion desk if the currency differs from the account base currency.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound disbursements for the MMORPG publishing business consist pre-paid expense for (a) the UK/Czech development studio, (b) the United States-based app-store platform taxes or the Bermuda ELP's remunerations, (c) Apple and Google payout settlement proceeds to the partners, and (d) vendor payments for server hosting and intellectual-property licensing. The clearing rails: for trades denominated in USD, the standard SWIFT MT103 payment order is suitable for correspondent-bank-cleared wires, with the credit in the beneficiary bank's account via the US Clearing House Interbank Payments System (CHIPS) or Fedwire; the MT103 must include the beneficiary bank's ABA and the ELP's full name and CC code, and the 'Details of Charges' field should be set to 'BEN', 'SHA', or 'OUR' depending on the vendor contract. Payments greater than a normal threshold to a China-based server vendor would require the reverse correspondent chain or direct renminbi settlement through an intermediary bank, but given that the MMORPG is global, the primary vendor currencies are USD, EUR, GBP, and CAD. For Trade Settlement through a Commercial Letter of Credit (LC), which is not needed for digital game publishing but may be used for licensing of physical merchandise or peripheral items, the ELP can use an irrevocable, confirmed at-sight LC payable via SWIFT MT700/MT710 and MT752 series through HSBC Bermuda or Butterfield; for digital-only revenue, a commercial LC is irrelevant. For disbursements to partners' annual profit distributions, the payout route is SWIFT MT103 or, for smaller distribution amounts, electronic funds transfer through the app-store payout account (but app-store payouts cannot be split directly to partners). Any outbound disbursement must be reconciled to the underlying Apple and Google payout schedules, ensuring that the VAT/withholding tax / GST obligations in the country of the payment receiver are the responsibility of the recipient or are handled by the ELP under the applicable platform-level withholding. The ELP's bank account in Bermuda should be the single 'gateway' for outbound liquidity, with a sub-ledger in the treasury ERP for each payment rail and a strict policy that no outbound payment is made to an unverified third party without correspondence to an executed contract and KYC evidence.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Bermuda Dollar (BMD) / United States Dollar (USD) is a pegged currency at 1:1, so no material FX hedging is required between BMD and USD accounts; the ELP may nonetheless execute spot conversions when depositing in BMD or use offshore USD clearances.

For USD-to-GBP exposure arising from UK development costs and Apple or Google GBP trade account receipts, the ELP may use deliverable forward FX contracts (plain-vanilla USD/GBP and EUR/USD forwards) with a licensed Bermuda bank or UK-listed bank trading desk, provided the bank is a BMA-licensed institution or the counterparty is an appropriately capitalised professional market counterparty; Bermuda's Exchange Control regime does not restrict forward hedging for non-financial end-user entities, but the transaction must be recorded with the bank and may be treated as a 'derivatives' transaction requiring a board/partner resolution.

For exposures to EUR/GBP and USD/EUR volatility in app-store settlements, the ELP may use no-deliverable forwards (NDFs) only where the underlying currency is a non-deliverable currency (e.g., emerging-market positions) or in circumstances where settlement is constrained; because USD, GBP, EUR, and CAD are deliverable, NDFs are not a natural instrument for the core MMORPG revenue, but if the ELP elects to hedge a portfolio of app-store distributions from jurisdictions with non-convertible or lightly traded currencies (e.g., RUB if Russian app-store payments are permitted through certain payout corridors), a non-deliverable forward referencing the RUB/USD rate with a London or New York prime broker may be permissible under UK EMIR hedging/end-user clearing exemption and Bermuda's DABA-related derivatives licensing exemption.

Currency swaps (cross-currency swaps) are permissible in principle for funding a USD-denominated profit distribution to a UK partner when the ELP holds a surplus in EUR: the ELP may enter a cross-currency interest rate swap (USD/EUR or USD/GBP) with an investment-grade bank under an ISDA Master Agreement, subject to the ELP's ability to post collateral and to a partnership authorisation under the Partnership Act 1902; because the ELP is a pass-through entity, any hedging gain or loss at the partnership level is allocated to partners for tax purposes under their respective tax regimes, and the bank will require a signed ISDA and a Credit Support Annex (CSA) if netting is needed.

In addition, the ELP may hold a multi-currency concentration account with the principal bank and execute internal 'natural offsets' without entering financial derivatives, e.g., by sweeping user-purchase GBP into a GBP operating account and using that account directly for UK vendors, and by sweeping USD payout funds into the USD account for Apple and Google settlement, thereby reducing external FX counterparty risk.

The ELP should establish an internal treasury policy limiting any leveraged or speculative FX positions, requiring board-level pre-approval for derivative notionals greater than the annual app-store payout volume, and excluding Bitcoin, Ethereum, stablecoin swaps, and other crypto assets from the permitted hedging set, given that the KY_ELP structure is a low-risk standard treasury and not a digital-asset business.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Companies, Government of Bermuda (Bermuda Corporate Registry)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on or before 31 January for a Bermuda exempted limited partnership with a calendar financial year; for non-calendar fiscal periods, within the deadline prescribed by the Registrar on registration, normally no later than 120 days after financial year-end.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing attracts Registrar penalties (typically BDA 250 to BDA 1,000); persistent failure to file or pay the annual government fee after formal notice may lead to administrative cancellation of the ELP registration and removal from the Register of Exempted Partnerships.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Bermuda Registrar of Companies (Economic Substance Unit)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by 30 June for calendar-year financial periods; for non-calendar financial periods, within six months after the end of the relevant financial period.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file the declaration is an offence under the Bermuda Economic Substance Act 2018, carrying financial penalties of up to BDA 100,000; continuing non-compliance may result in administrative strike-off and reporting to the Bermuda Minister of Finance and relevant international tax authorities.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Bermuda law does not impose a mandatory statutory audit on exempted limited partnerships. An audit of the ELP becomes compulsory only where: (i) the partnership agreement or investor covenants expressly require audited financial statements; (ii) the ELP carries on a relevant activity under the Economic Substance Act 2018 and the Registrar or competent authority requires audited accounts in support of the economic substance declaration; or (iii) the corporate general partner is subject to audit under its home-jurisdiction corporate law and group consolidation rules.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Bermuda does not prescribe a domestic local GAAP. Financial statements of an ELP are commonly prepared in accordance with IFRS; US GAAP is also accepted where the ultimate parent or investors are US-based and require financial statements prepared for consolidated reporting purposes.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Bermuda does not require an annual UBO return for exempted limited partnerships. The general partner must maintain a current register of limited partners and beneficial owners at the registered office in Bermuda. On any transfer of a partnership interest or change in beneficial ownership, the register must be updated promptly (generally within 14 days) and the registered office notified without delay. The annual Exempted Partnership Declaration confirms that these statutory records are maintained at the registered office. Beneficial ownership information is also accessible to Bermuda competent authorities under the Beneficial Ownership Act 2017 but is not publicly filed.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of General Partner (including directors of a corporate general partner, if applicable)
Minute Book and Written Resolutions of the General Partner or Management Committee
Register of Charges and Encumbrances (if any)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 1,800 - USD 3,500 per year covering registered office, corporate secretarial support, AML/KYC register maintenance, and registered agent services
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 5,000 - USD 12,000 per year for a small to mid-sized MMORPG publishing ELP where a contractual or investor-driven audit is required; otherwise USD 0

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% at the Bermuda exempted limited partnership (ELP) level; Bermuda imposes no corporate income tax, no capital gains tax and no VAT/sales tax, and the ELP is tax-transparent (pass-through) with profits allocated to partners. A 15% Bermuda Corporate Income Tax (CIT Act 2023) and a 15% Qualified Domestic Minimum Top-up Tax (QDMTT) apply only to constituent entities of multinational groups with consolidated revenue of EUR 750 million or more in at least two of the four preceding fiscal years; the hardcore MMORPG ELP falls outside this scope unless the wider group crosses the threshold.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No statutory tax holidays or preferential deductions exist in Bermuda. The effective Bermuda tax rate for an out-of-scope ELP is nil at entity level and nil on distributions to partners. The practical global effective rate depends on the tax residence of the partners: UK-resident corporate partners are chargeable at UK corporation tax rates up to 25% on their profit share, and in-scope groups face the 15% GloBE/QDMTT top-up. The ELP enjoys full tax transparency, exemption from Bermuda exchange control on non-resident holdings, and no capital duty or stamp duty on its global MMORPG licensing and in-app purchase revenue.
